_comment: Source of truth for league rules. verify_league checks scoring_settings, roster_positions and the league settings it maps (teams, IR, waivers, playoffs, trade deadline, divisions) against Sleeper's GET /v1/league/<league_id> and fails loudly on mismatch.
_roster_comment: Verified against live roster_positions on 2026-09-23. roster_positions lists the 13 active slots only -- Sleeper never puts IR there, so its absence from that list (and from the draft object's slots_*) does NOT mean the league has no IR. See ir below.

ir._comment: Corrected 2026-10-21. There ARE 2 IR slots: live settings.reserve_slots = 2, and one roster already has a player in its reserve list. The 2026-09-23 'no IR' finding read roster_positions, which never contains IR on Sleeper. Eligible statuses come from settings.reserve_allow_*: out, sus and dnr are 1; dtd, doubtful, na and cov are 0 -- a day-to-day player cannot be stashed. An IR player costs no active roster spot, so SPEC §7.2's IR strategy applies after all. verify_league checks all of this against the live league.

_from_live_settings: Read off the live league on 2026-09-23. These were absent from the original transcription and none of them are yet reflected in docs/SPEC.md. Values are Sleeper's, not inferred.

keepers._resolved: NO KEEPERS. Confirmed 2026-09-23 on three independent signals: settings.type=0 (redraft; 1=keeper, 2=dynasty), all 8 pre-draft rosters have players=[] and keepers=[], and the draft is 13 rounds for 13 roster spots, which leaves no room for a kept player. Sleeper still reports max_keepers=1 -- that is an inert platform default in a redraft league, NOT a league rule. Do not reopen this from that field alone.
keepers._previous_league_note: This league continues last season's. Nothing carries over, but that league's completed draft is real data for the M5 dress rehearsal (docs/TASKS.md M5, SPEC §9.6) -- a replayable 8-team snake draft with the same managers.

waivers._comment: Corrected 2026-10-21: NO FAAB, confirmed by the user in the Sleeper app. Claims are decided by waiver priority (each roster's settings.waiver_position, 1-8). Evidence in the data: week 1's completed waiver claim carries settings {seq: 0} and no waiver_bid, and every roster's waiver_budget_used is 0. settings.waiver_budget = 100 is a platform default present whether or not bidding is on -- do not read FAAB from it, which is the mistake the 2026-09-23 note made. order: reverse standings, confirmed by the user in the app 2026-10-21 -- so waiver_type 1 means reverse standings (verify_league compares the code verbatim). Priority resets with the standings rather than moving a team to the back after a claim, so a successful claim costs nothing for later weeks; the worse your record, the better your priority. clear_days: a dropped player sits on waivers 1 day, then is a free agent. after_game_start: a free agent whose game has tipped off goes back on waivers, so pickups have to happen before his game.

draft_settings_live._note: The draft object's rounds=13 is the real value (13 x 8 = 104 picks, matching SPEC). The league-level settings.draft_rounds=3 is a stale default -- do not read it. start_time is still null, so the draft is not yet scheduled.

_scoring_comment: Key names are Sleeper's own, taken verbatim from the live GET /league/<id> scoring_settings on 2026-09-23, so verify_league compares them with no translation step. The five that were renamed from the original transcription (tpm<-fg3m, tf<-tech_foul, ff<-flagrant_foul, bonus_pt_40p<-bonus_40_pts, bonus_pt_50p<-bonus_50_pts) kept identical values, and the live payload has exactly these 13 keys and no others. engine/model/scoring.py maps them to readable box-score field names.

scoring_ambiguities._comment: RESOLVED 2026-10-22, both true, by engine/jobs/resolve_scoring.py against last season's league (1275683545209122816: identical scoring_settings, Lock-In). For each of 2666 player-weeks, every game he played was rescored under all four flag combinations and compared with the score Sleeper counted (matchup players_points). 2612 could not tell the combinations apart; 54 could (triple-doubles and 50-point games), and ONLY bonuses_stack=true + td_includes_dd=true matched all 54. The alternatives matched 0/54 (both false, the old default), 8/54 (stack only) and 45/54 (dd only). 0 of the 2666 matched no combination, so the rest of the scoring is confirmed too. Decisive case: Jokic week 10, Sleeper 128, matched only by both true. Rerun the job to re-check.

bonuses_stack.question: Does a 50-point game score both bonus_40_pts and bonus_50_pts (7) or only bonus_50_pts (4)? Both: 7.

td_includes_dd.question: Does a triple-double also award the double-double bonus (7 total) or only the triple-double bonus (4)? Both: 7.

quadruple_double.question: Rare enough to ignore, but do not crash on it.

lock_in_rules.must_lock_before: that player's next game tips off
lock_in_rules.eligible_only_if: player was in the starting lineup when that game began
lock_in_rules.no_lock_fallback: team's final game of the week is used, which is 0 if the player did not play
lock_in_rules.post_lock: player's slot is fixed for the week and he cannot be moved or reused

strategy_constants._comment: Derived from the settings above. Used by the valuation engine.
